integrity: Mathematical proof and finite reproducibility checks supplied; finite scripts are corroboration, not a substitute for all-parameter proof; no independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The all-length sharp capacity and first-attainment classification apply to fixed labeled alphabets of size at least three, for linear words and exactly one changed source letter. The result does not classify all shorter-length maxima, multiple edits, circular profiles, or reconstruction-code sizes. Historical priority beyond inspected literature and independent validation remain unresolved.
title: Sharp one-substitution dinucleotide-profile capacity and de Bruijn saturation
